definitions.gloss: unlucky day; inauspicious day; most unfavorable day
definitions.explanation: The most inauspicious day in the traditional Japanese six-day calendar cycle (六曜 rokuyo). Weddings, celebrations, and business openings are typically avoided on this day.

examples.english: I want to avoid days that fall on butsumetsu.

examples.japanese: {仏滅|ぶつめつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{結婚式|けっこんしき}→結婚式：05493_kekkonshiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{安|やす}く→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Weddings on unlucky days can sometimes be cheaper.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{仏滅|ぶつめつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大事|だいじ}→大事：01253_daiji⟧なこと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めない→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧ようにして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: My grandmother avoids starting anything important on unlucky days.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
Despite the name containing {仏|ぶつ} (Buddha) and {滅|めつ} (destruction), {仏滅|ぶつめつ} has no connection to Buddhism. It is part of the ⟦{六曜|ろくよう}→六曜：29161_rokuyou⟧ system, a folk calendar tradition. Younger generations tend to care less about {仏滅|ぶつめつ}, but it still influences wedding and event planning.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {仏滅|ぶつめつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧ (an unlucky day)
- {仏滅|ぶつめつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}ける→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧ (to avoid unlucky days)
- {仏滅|ぶつめつ}⟦{割引|わりびき}→割引：01526_waribiki⟧ (butsumetsu discount — offered by wedding venues)
